description: Standardised mobile communicator retrieval, holding, and repositioning sequence.

steps.name: START
steps.description: Experiment initialized. Ready to begin phone handling sequence.
steps.next_suggestion: Place phone on workspace table in camera view.

steps.name: DETECT_PHONE
steps.description: Baseline verification: Phone detected stationary on surface.
steps.next_suggestion: Reach towards and pick up the phone with hand.

steps.name: PICK_PHONE
steps.description: Operator grasps and lifts phone with hand interaction.
steps.next_suggestion: Hold phone elevated in grasp for telemetry confirmation.

steps.name: HOLD_PHONE
steps.description: Operator holds phone securely in grasp.
steps.next_suggestion: Place phone back down onto workstation surface.

steps.name: PLACE_PHONE_DOWN
steps.description: Operator places phone back down onto workspace surface.
steps.next_suggestion: Withdraw hands from phone to complete placement verification.

steps.name: VERIFY_PLACED
steps.description: Verification: Phone stationary on surface, hands retracted clear.

steps.name: COMPLETED
steps.description: Phone pickup protocol successfully completed and validated.
